name: harness-swarm
description: Dispatch qodercli, kimi, pi, grok, codex, claude, dsh, and opencode from Codex into isolated git worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Run eight coding harnesses in worktrees
interface.longDescription: Codex plugin that lists installed coding harnesses and runs one headless job at a time in an independent git worktree. Returns evidence; never auto-merges.
